name: starward
description: Procedural open-universe space sandbox RPG built with three.js — by Jeremy Anderson Tech

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2020 --outfile=dist/game.js && cp index.html dist/ && cp docs/images/og.jpg dist/og.jpg && mkdir -p dist/images && cp docs/images/*.jpg dist/images/ && cp -r docs/images/webp dist/images/ && mkdir -p dist/music && (cp music/*.mp3 dist/music/ 2>/dev/null || true) && cd dist && rm -f starward-html5.zip starward-html5-offline.zip && zip -qr starward-html5.zip index.html game.js og.jpg && rm -f starward-html5-offline.zip && zip -qr starward-html5-offline.zip index.html game.js og.jpg music

author: Jeremy Anderson Tech (https://jeremyanderson.tech/)
